definitions.explanation: In baseball, the outfielder who covers left field, positioned to the left of center field as seen from home plate.

examples.japanese: {左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}がフライを{取|と}る。
examples.english: The left fielder catches a fly ball.

examples.japanese: この{左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}は{打撃|だげき}も{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: This left fielder is also good at hitting.

examples.japanese: {左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ}がフェンス{際|ぎわ}でボールを{捕|と}らえた。
examples.english: The left fielder caught the ball right at the fence.

notes:
Compound of {左翼|さよく} (left wing) + {手|しゅ} (player). The outfielder who covers left field. Colloquially called レフト.

RELATED POSITIONS:
- {右翼|うよく}{手|しゅ}: right fielder
- {中堅|ちゅうけん}{手|しゅ}: center fielder

As with {右翼|うよく}, {左翼|さよく} alone often refers to the political left wing; {左翼|さよく}{手|しゅ} is specifically the baseball position.
